name: Bissee (Germany)
description: Red field with a broad band of blue and white wavy stripes across the middle, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bissee (a crowned red boar's head on white and blue wavy).
history: Municipal flag of Bissee; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: barry wavy of blue and white across the middle
